title: [29.X]-[BE] Intervat XML Report 11307 Does Not Include Non-Deductible VAT Amount Reflected in VAT Statement Preview
summary: The Intervat XML Report 11307 now correctly includes non-deductible VAT amounts reflected in the VAT Statement Preview for Belgium.
key_points: Fixed a bug where non-deductible VAT amounts were missing from the Intervat XML Report 11307
The VAT Statement Line table was adjusted to reflect the correct amounts
Test coverage was added to verify the fix works correctly
Addresses a Belgium-specific VAT reporting requirement
